title: Psychiatry and behavioral science
stage: College neuroscience and cognitive science degree
audience: a college student in a neuroscience, cognitive science, psychology or biology degree program, or an adult studying the same material on their own
purpose: Integrate the psychiatric assessment with depressive, bipolar, anxiety, obsessive-compulsive, trauma-related, psychotic, substance use, personality, eating, sleep and neurodevelopmental disorders, risk assessment and emergencies, psychopharmacology and psychotherapy.

weeks.1: The psychiatric assessment and mental status examination

blocks.deliverable: Write a mental status examination from a transcript.
Distinguish mania from hypomania and choose first-line treatments.
Week 7 midterm; describe the personality disorder clusters.
Structure a risk assessment and a safety plan.
Match medications to their uses and serious adverse effects.
Submit the project; take an unseen 150 minute final in week 14.

project: Psychiatric interview and plan: from three supplied transcripts, write the mental status examination, the diagnosis and a safety-focused treatment plan.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
